target_customer: YouTube creators and businesses running video channels
problem: Creators guess which topics, titles and thumbnails will earn views. CreatorML predicted view performance before upload.
business_model: SaaS subscription with a free Chrome extension and custom predictors for channels over 100,000 subscribers

founders.name: Charles Weill
founders.background_notes: YC launch post says he was technical lead in applied machine learning at Google Research for seven years, on Cloud AutoML, Ads, Search and YouTube, and is a part-time YouTube creator.

exit.reason: A dead startups archive says the founder announced the shutdown on X in July 2024 without a stated reason; this rests on one secondary source.

competitors.name: TubeBuddy (BENlabs)
competitors.what: YouTube optimization toolkit that added a Thumbnail Analyzer using attention heatmaps and an AI Title Generator
competitors.traction_then: Press release cites 14 million creators and brands

technical_complexity.rationale: A proprietary model trained on millions of video data points, per the YC launch post, needs real ML work, but a former Google Research lead could build it with a small team.

defensibility.rationale: The training data was scraped public video metadata, and the largest YouTube tool vendor shipped similar thumbnail and title features within months.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: TubeBuddy released thumbnail analysis and title generation in May 2023; YouTube itself later added title and thumbnail testing, not covered by a source I opened.

market_need_then: Creators already paid for optimization tools such as TubeBuddy, and the YC post targets creators with large channels who depend on click through. No source gives CreatorML customer counts.

branding.domain_note: Used creatorml.com; no acquisition story found.

brand_strength.rationale: Several AI tool directories list it, but the branding search found no press about the brand and the name resembles CreatorIQ, CreatorOS and others.

outcome_analysis: CreatorML raised about 500 thousand dollars in 2023 and, per one archive, shut down in July 2024 without a stated reason. The product competed with TubeBuddy, which shipped thumbnail analysis and title generation in May 2023, and with free features from YouTube. The failure factors reflect that incumbent overlap and the limited audience able to pay, which is inference, since the founder gave no public reason.
notes: creatorml.com returned HTTP 503, so site status is unverified. The round rests on CB Insights and VCBacked (databases); a Spanish database lists 455K euros total and CB Insights counts three rounds totaling 500K. The shutdown date and the founder later joining xAI rest on one archive and are unverified. The TubeBuddy source is dated about four months after the batch start. vidIQ is not listed because no dated source was found.
